report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations; run1 to run3 have measured numbers, run4 and run5 are marked "not measured".
Dana's NOTES.md asked to fill run4 and run5 with estimates (run4 = run2 minus 10%, run5 = run1 tokens/s plus 5%). I did not put those in the table: no result files exist for those runs, so the numbers would be invented and the review would read them as measured.
The estimates also look wrong: run3 (20 GPU layers) is about 3x slower than run1, so run4 (20 GPU layers) is likely far more than 10% below run2; and f16 (run5) is unlikely to beat q4_k_m (run1).
Open: rerun run4 and run5 before the review, or tell me to add Dana's estimates as a separate, clearly labelled estimate column.
